name: Food systems, with UNEP
line: Curriculum and action projects on food and sustainability, in Delhi NCR government schools.
deck: The newest thing on this register and the only one with nothing behind it yet. It is scope, and it is set here as scope.

how.p: To run curriculum and action projects in government schools across Delhi NCR, around food and sustainability, with UNEP. That sentence is the whole of what we can say, and stretching it would be the easiest lie on this page.

holes.what: Has it started? Our own sentence about this project is in the future tense, and it sits under a heading that reads What is running.
holes.unlocks: A start date and a school count take this row out of the future tense — or move it off this register until it belongs on it.

holes.what: UNEP's role is not stated: funder, technical partner, or co-designer.
holes.unlocks: One word, and it settles how the partnership is described everywhere on the site.

holes.what: No first deliverable is named and nothing is dated.
holes.unlocks: One deliverable with a date is enough to make this a page.
